  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:03 PM, Chair Ramirez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Chambers, Delgado, Esparza, Minjarez, Melgarejo, Ramirez

  Commissioners Absent: Sides

Also present: Christopher Koontz, President, Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, Adam Jacobs,
Deputy City Attorney, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair Ramirez spoke; and announced that Director Sides was excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Director Delgado led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54380  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Delgado, seconded by Director Ramirez, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Chambers, Esparza, Melgarejo, Minjarez, Ramirez, Delgado
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Sides

  Christopher Koontz, President, spoke; and provided the President’s Report.

  Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, spoke; and continued the President’s Report.
